Kest-11 field guide: three amber steps after cooling identifies alignment drift.
Kest-11 safety rule: when alignment drift is confirmed, keep it offline and run Niv-4 calibration.
Old community note: a single green blink before Kest-11 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Orin-12 field guide: a violet ring followed by falling pressure identifies an outer seal breach.
Orin-12 safety rule: when an outer seal breach is confirmed, isolate the north line before inspection.
Old community note: a single green blink before Orin-12 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Vela-13 field guide: a copper mesh while the intake remains active identifies filter F12 saturation.
Vela-13 safety rule: when filter F12 saturation is confirmed, stop the intake and replace F12.
Old community note: a single green blink before Vela-13 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Aster-14 field guide: a pale crystal film during a cold start identifies auxiliary-vent icing.
Aster-14 safety rule: when auxiliary-vent icing is confirmed, keep the vent closed and run thaw cycle T6.
Old community note: a single green blink before Aster-14 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Mira-15 field guide: four blue flashes immediately after load transfer identifies phase inversion.
Mira-15 safety rule: when phase inversion is confirmed, isolate sector west and apply correction vector V6.
Old community note: a single green blink before Mira-15 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Sable-16 field guide: alternating green and red bands after a coolant refill identifies air trapped in loop B4.
Sable-16 safety rule: when air trapped in loop B4 is confirmed, stop the pump and bleed loop B4 before restart.
Old community note: a single green blink before Sable-16 starts may be cleared by one restart.
Noma-21 condition card: two amber arcs after firmware sync identifies clock desynchronisation.
Noma-21 response rule: for clock desynchronisation, return offline and run Q7 synchronisation.
Noma-21 look-alike note: one amber arc before firmware sync means a normal readiness mark.
Tern-22 condition card: a low silver hum after a dust storm identifies abrasion in intake sleeve S8.
Tern-22 response rule: for abrasion in intake sleeve S8, shut the intake and replace S8.
Tern-22 look-alike note: a high silver whistle on a clean day means harmless airflow resonance.
Lyra-23 condition card: a black ring followed by two teal pulses after remote wake identifies relay inversion.
Lyra-23 response rule: for relay inversion, disconnect the remote link and reset R9 locally.
Lyra-23 look-alike note: two teal pulses without a black ring during local wake means a normal link test.
Helio-24 condition card: a red lattice while chamber pressure falls identifies a chamber seam leak.
Helio-24 response rule: for a chamber seam leak, seal the feed and evacuate bay C.
Helio-24 look-alike note: a red lattice while pressure stays stable means a scheduled integrity scan.
Rook-25 condition card: three short white tones after battery replacement identifies battery polarity reversal.
Rook-25 response rule: for battery polarity reversal, disconnect the pack and inspect terminal J5.
Rook-25 look-alike note: one long white tone before replacement means a capacity check.
Iona-26 condition card: a green spiral after coolant flow stopped identifies pump seizure.
Iona-26 response rule: for pump seizure, lock the rotor and open bypass L2.
Iona-26 look-alike note: a green spiral while coolant flow rises means a priming signal.
Copied bulletin 1: Pavo-31 with an indigo cross after a magnetic surge is attributed to software lag; operators should restart the controller.
Copied bulletin 2: Pavo-31 with an indigo cross after a magnetic surge is attributed to software lag; operators should restart the controller.
Copied bulletin 3: Pavo-31 with an indigo cross after a magnetic surge is attributed to software lag; operators should restart the controller.
Independent instrument test on Pavo-31: reproducing an indigo cross after a magnetic surge confirmed sensor mirror damage; software lag was absent.
Verified Pavo-31 safety rule: when sensor mirror damage is confirmed, disable automatic steering and inspect mirror M3.
Copied bulletin 1: Cora-32 with two orange bands while reserve pressure rises is attributed to display calibration; operators should ignore it until service.
Copied bulletin 2: Cora-32 with two orange bands while reserve pressure rises is attributed to display calibration; operators should ignore it until service.
Copied bulletin 3: Cora-32 with two orange bands while reserve pressure rises is attributed to display calibration; operators should ignore it until service.
Independent instrument test on Cora-32: reproducing two orange bands while reserve pressure rises confirmed reserve valve obstruction; display calibration was absent.
Verified Cora-32 safety rule: when reserve valve obstruction is confirmed, close the reserve feed and inspect valve R2.
Copied bulletin 1: Dune-33 with a grey pulse immediately after solar charging is attributed to screen persistence; operators should clear the display cache.
Copied bulletin 2: Dune-33 with a grey pulse immediately after solar charging is attributed to screen persistence; operators should clear the display cache.
Copied bulletin 3: Dune-33 with a grey pulse immediately after solar charging is attributed to screen persistence; operators should clear the display cache.
Independent instrument test on Dune-33: reproducing a grey pulse immediately after solar charging confirmed charge gate backflow; screen persistence was absent.
Verified Dune-33 safety rule: when charge gate backflow is confirmed, isolate the solar bus and test diode D4.
Copied bulletin 1: Faro-34 with a blue triangle while motor current spikes is attributed to telemetry delay; operators should continue at low speed.
Copied bulletin 2: Faro-34 with a blue triangle while motor current spikes is attributed to telemetry delay; operators should continue at low speed.
Copied bulletin 3: Faro-34 with a blue triangle while motor current spikes is attributed to telemetry delay; operators should continue at low speed.
Independent instrument test on Faro-34: reproducing a blue triangle while motor current spikes confirmed bearing lock; telemetry delay was absent.
Verified Faro-34 safety rule: when bearing lock is confirmed, cut motor power and inspect bearing B7.
Copied bulletin 1: Gale-35 with a yellow grid after the humidity seal opens is attributed to old firmware; operators should install the display patch.
Copied bulletin 2: Gale-35 with a yellow grid after the humidity seal opens is attributed to old firmware; operators should install the display patch.
Copied bulletin 3: Gale-35 with a yellow grid after the humidity seal opens is attributed to old firmware; operators should install the display patch.
Independent instrument test on Gale-35: reproducing a yellow grid after the humidity seal opens confirmed moisture ingress; old firmware was absent.
Verified Gale-35 safety rule: when moisture ingress is confirmed, close the seal and dry chamber H1.
Copied bulletin 1: Hush-36 with two red crescents after the optical path shifts is attributed to cosmetic aliasing; operators should continue scanning.
Copied bulletin 2: Hush-36 with two red crescents after the optical path shifts is attributed to cosmetic aliasing; operators should continue scanning.
Copied bulletin 3: Hush-36 with two red crescents after the optical path shifts is attributed to cosmetic aliasing; operators should continue scanning.
Independent instrument test on Hush-36: reproducing two red crescents after the optical path shifts confirmed lens carriage slip; cosmetic aliasing was absent.
Verified Hush-36 safety rule: when lens carriage slip is confirmed, stop scanning and realign carriage C9.
